_comment: TRON 'zen token' interface mapping. Constants mirror bds-tron/src/test/resources/testng.conf and java-tron's CommonParameter.zenTokenId (node config knob, default '000000' = disabled). The zen token is the fee/settlement TRC10 of TRON's shielded-transfer actuator (actuator/ShieldedTransferActuator: fee is burned to the blackhole in zenTokenId; transparent_from/to_address carry value in/out of the shielded pool).
note: Sender 417e5f4552091a69125d5dfcb7b8c2659029395bdf (TMVQGm1q...) is 2-of-2: owner#1 = our key, owner#2 = TY2YRt63pM7YorXV8WNpfb3qQyvyTZzzuC. Active permissions allow TransferAsset/TriggerSmartContract but threshold is 2, so a second signature is required. zenTokenOwner account holds 0 zen tokens on both mainnet and shasta (must be funded before a shielded transfer can pay the 10000000 zen fee).
